#!/bin/bash
# Auto-generated by Infrahub - do not edit by hand.
# VM: fra1-vm-win01
# Host: fra1-esx-01
# Cluster: FRA1-ESXI-CLUSTER (vmware)
set -euo pipefail

# Cloud-init user-data rendered by Infrahub (see the vm-userdata artifact).
USERDATA_B64="$(base64 -w0 <<'CLOUDINIT'
#cloud-config
# VM: fra1-vm-win01 (Windows guest - cloudbase-init)
set_hostname: fra1-vm-win01
users:
  - name: Admin
    groups: Administrators
    ssh_authorized_keys:
      - ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAA demo@opsmill
# NOTE: no password is stored in Infrahub. Set the first-boot Administrator
# password at deploy time (cloudbase-init inject or console).
CLOUDINIT
)"
METADATA_B64="$(base64 -w0 <<METADATA
instance-id: fra1-vm-win01
local-hostname: fra1-vm-win01
METADATA
)"

govc vm.clone -vm "tpl-windows-server-2022" -on=false \
  -c 4 -m 16384 \
  "fra1-vm-win01"

govc vm.disk.change -vm "fra1-vm-win01" -size 120G

govc vm.change -vm "fra1-vm-win01" \
  -e "guestinfo.userdata=$USERDATA_B64" \
  -e "guestinfo.userdata.encoding=base64" \
  -e "guestinfo.metadata=$METADATA_B64" \
  -e "guestinfo.metadata.encoding=base64"

govc vm.power -on "fra1-vm-win01"
